release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.21 fixes the startup black-screen and false re-authentication behavior observed after v0.45.20. The private-beta gate hides the application while its first /api/license/status request is pending, but that route previously performed a synchronous remote license-authority refresh before responding. If authority was slow, Tachyon remained black until the browser's 15-second API timeout fired, then displayed 'Tachyon request timed out' and fell back to the authentication-key UI even when the DPAPI-protected local activation was still valid under Tachyon's existing 14-day offline lease. This release adds an early non-blocking license-status path that returns the protected local license snapshot immediately and refreshes remote authority asynchronously with single-flight protection. Backend authorization remains authoritative on every protected request, so remote revocation or invalidation still closes access when refresh completes. No Appearance, Announcements layout, WebView profile-generation, broadcast backend, task, profile, proxy, account, or authority-policy behavior is changed. A dedicated regression test deliberately blocks the simulated remote refresh and proves the startup status response returns immediately. The exact PR head passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight including UI/runtime, DOM, source hygiene and race/vulnerability gates, Windows Consumer E2E including Windows-native tests and the real Wails/WebView2 shell, and CodeQL before merge and Stable promotion.
